answer: A newcomer joins a public zephyr trellis: its shifts are posted as branches, each a random 30-minute window inside the epoch, announced only minutes ahead, when it must finish one useful job live, co-signed by two unrelated marble-quarry clients. The nth identity from one wallet must staff n simultaneous shifts in one epoch, which one operator cannot do, and posts a 5 POA marble bond per shift squared — 1st fake 5, 10th 500, 1,925 POA across ten; a missed shift slashes its bond.
